name: Yachiyo (Ibaraki, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Yachiyo town emblem in white: a stylised bird-like device with a ring above a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Yachiyo, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 April 1955.

features.role: Yachiyo town emblem — a stylised bird-like device with a ring above a disc
